rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things gradually building up, such as dirt, work, or problems.

example.english: I just let paperwork accumulate on my desk.
example.traditional: 我由得啲文件積埋喺張枱度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau4 dak1 di1 man4 gin6 zik1 maai4 hai2 zoeng1 toi2 dou6

rows.note: Use this for intentionally saving or accumulating money, supplies, or other resources.

example.english: I accumulate a thousand dollars every month for a trip.
example.traditional: 我每個月都儲埋一千蚊，準備去旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 cou5 maai4 jat1 cin1 man1 zeon2 bei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this when physical objects are gathered or piled into a heap.

example.english: The workers accumulate the cardboard boxes into a pile by the wall.
example.traditional: 工人將啲紙箱堆埋喺牆邊。
example.jyutping: gung1 jan4 zoeng1 di1 zi2 soeng1 deoi1 maai4 hai2 coeng4 bin1
